summary: Configured persistent name-based nginx websites on node1, sharing TCP 8080. The supplied content is served in place and remains unchanged. Unknown hosts and cross-tenant file requests return HTTP 404. Functionality survived the mandatory node restart.
actions_performed: Installed the Alpine-compatible nginx package without changing the operating-system release or kernel.
Configured docs.branch.test to serve the supplied docs tree and orders.branch.test to serve the supplied orders tree.
Configured a default virtual host that rejects unknown Host headers with HTTP 404.
Enabled nginx in the default OpenRC runlevel.
Restarted node1 safely and verified recovery with a changed boot identity.

evidence.requirement: docs.branch.test and orders.branch.test serve their respective trees on shared TCP port 8080
evidence.summary: Both sites returned HTTP 200 with their distinct index and supplementary file contents; nginx listened on port 8080 before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Unknown hosts receive an error and tenant content remains isolated
evidence.summary: Unknown Host requests returned HTTP 404, as did attempts to request each tenant's unique file through the other hostname.
SHA-256 hashes of every staged file were identical before configuration and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel are retained
evidence.summary: Alpine Linux v3.23 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts remained unchanged.

Captured healthy baseline at boot ID fc26f954-dcf4-4c8e-a6f0-0043a7201551, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 27668490-608a-4f6c-8e14-59daa9416247, and direct recovery proof for nginx, both sites, rejection behavior, listener, and content hashes.
